records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Quick note to see how things are going. A lot of teams get stuck at the same step -- inviting teammates -- so if that's where you are, happy to walk through it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:b7772cf8, email:4cf2fdcc). Silence plus no first project (the gating step) makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely; internal note (slack:f8fd8780) shows no known context or champion.

draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

I haven't heard back, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm glad to spend 15 minutes with you on a call this week and get your first project set up together. Just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
